caption:
Save this before you fill the CHRIST form 📌

CHRIST has six campuses with entrance-test BBA routes for 2027. Here is every one:

🔵 Bangalore Central: BBA, BBA (Decision Science), BBA LLB
🟣 Bannerghatta Road: 4 BBA routes
🟢 Kengeri: BBA, BBA (Applied Finance with FinTech)
🟠 Yeshwanthpur: 5 BBA routes
🔴 Delhi NCR: 6 BBA routes, incl. BBA LLB
🩵 Pune Lavasa: BBA, BBA (Business Analytics), BBA LLB

The BBA paper: 120 marks in 90 minutes. English + GK 45, Reasoning 25, Maths + DI 40, Fundamental Accounting 10. Wrong answers cost 0.25.

Key dates: apply by 25 Nov 2026, test on 5 Dec, SA, MP and PI from 11 to 13 Dec, final list on 21 Dec.

Apply only on christuniversity.in.

Which campus is your first choice? Tell us in the comments 👇
Send this to the friend who still thinks CHRIST has one BBA.

#ChristUniversity #BBA2027 #IPMAT2027 #IPMCareers

claims.claim: Selection steps: online entrance test, then SA, MP and PI in person at the venue chosen in the form; SA = write on a topic for up to 10 minutes, MP = talk for 90 seconds, PI = 10 minutes
claims.quote: Skill Assessment (SA): Candidates will be asked to write on a given topic for not more than one A4 size sheet and for not more than 10 minutes. / Micro Presentation (MP): Candidate should be able to talk for 90seconds / Personal interview (PI): duration: 10 minutes / Entrance Test: ONLINE / SA_MP_PI: VENUE BASED

claims.claim: BBA paper: English 25 + GK 20 = 45, Fundamental Accounting 10, Reasoning 25, Maths 20 + DI 20 = 40, total 120; 90 minutes; +1 / minus 0.25 / 0 for unattempted
claims.quote: BBA | BBA (Business Analytics) | BBA (Finance and Economics) ... English (25) | General Knowledge (20) 45 / Fundamental Accounting 10 / Reasoning 25 / Mathematics (20) | Data Analysis & Interpretation (20) 40 / TOTAL MARKS 120 ... Entrance test duration: 90 Minutes except if otherwise specified ... Each question carries 1 mark for the right answer and a negative mark of 0.25 for the wrong answer. No marks are awarded or deducted for unattempted questions.

claims.claim: BBA (Decision Science) has its own paper including design thinking; BBA LLB uses the same paper as BA LLB
claims.quote: BBA (Decision Science) ... Quantitive Aptitude (10) | Design Thinking for problem Solving (10) 20 / Pattern Recongnition 12 ... BALLB | BBALLB English (30) | General Knowledge (30) 60 ...
